messages:
elaine (sec-eng): Heads-up — noticed Admin role lost read access to cost/usage dashboards after RBAC refactor rolling out this morning. Customers reporting 403s when hitting /admin/usage and internal billing UI blank.
ben (infra): confirmed in staging. The role mapping table shows AdminRole -> [] for billing scopes. Looks like the migration script zeroed that column for a subset of orgs.
sarah (oncall): any active incidents? not customer-facing outage yet but billing team sees missing metrics. Tracking as P1 for visibility.
mike (product): impact: product analytics and quota dashboards depend on that permission. Need quick mitigation and a rollback plan.
elaine (sec-eng): Triage notes: permission we expected is "billing.view_usage" (scope name). Old code had a fallback that implicitly allowed legacy_admin boolean; v2 RBAC removed fallback. The migration was supposed to add the new scopes but I see a WHERE filter that dropped orgs with legacy=false.
ben (infra): repro steps: run curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <admin-token>" https://api.redwood.ai/admin/usage -> 403 {"error":"permission_denied","missing":"billing.view_usage"} . Audit log shows permission_check_failure with request_id rqd_0a1b2c3.
elaine (sec-eng): quick mitigation options: 1) reapply missing scope to AdminRole for affected orgs via patch script 2) re-enable legacy_admin fallback flag for 1 hour behind feature flag fl_rbac_v2 3) emergency grant to service-account ops-internal (temporary). I prefer option 1 + audit log assert.
ben (infra): I'll draft the migration fix and run in a single-transaction patch for the affected tenant IDs. Adding a guard to not touch tenants already migrated.
mike (product): please coordinate with support to notify customers who reported it. Add note about potential stale invoices if analytics backfilled.
elaine (sec-eng): also: KMS note — some billing keys rotate weekly; ensure migration script does not attempt to decrypt policy blobs with an old KMS version. We should fail safe (log and skip) not zero out scopes.
elaine (sec-eng): snippet of the buggy SQL we found:```
-- broken migration snippet
UPDATE role_mappings SET scopes = '{}' WHERE migration_tag = 'rbac_v2' AND legacy_admin = false;
```
ben (infra): proposed fix:```
-- safer patch
UPDATE role_mappings rm
SET scopes = jsonb_union(rm.scopes, '"billing.view_usage"')
FROM (SELECT id FROM role_mappings WHERE migration_tag='rbac_v2' AND (scopes->'billing.view_usage') IS NULL) tgt
WHERE rm.id = tgt.id;
```
elaine (sec-eng): add audit events for both the migration action and the permission checks. We want a record: actor, before_scopes, after_scopes, request_id. Audit-bot: noted. Will emit events with type migration.scope_change.
audit-bot: logged migration.scope_change for 12 tenants, request trace rqd_0a1b2c3.
sarah (oncall): deploy-bot, please hold any further rbac_v2 flags until we patch.
deploy-bot: paused feature flag fl_rbac_v2 at 1876543500 per request.
ben (infra): I'll run the fix in canary (3 tenants) then schedule full rollout. ETA 45m. Will attach runbook and rollback SQL.
mike (product): +1 on customer comms. I'll draft a short note and checklist.
elaine (sec-eng): assigning action items: ben -> migration patch + canary, sarah -> incident timeline & customer comms, mike -> support note, me -> audit/triage + postmortem draft.
sarah (oncall): ack. Creating INCIDENT-202903 in PagerDuty and linking thread.
elaine (sec-eng): postmortem will include root cause: overly-broad WHERE in migration + missing audit guard + feature-flag roll order. Lessons: add unit test for migration idempotency, assert KMS decrypt success before mutating, and require migration dry-run logs.
ben (infra): running canary now. Will post logs and SQL diffs after.
elaine (sec-eng): thanks — mark urgent and tag legal if customers ask about billing discrepancies.
mike (product): noted. keeping this thread as primary source.
